selection: Earliest strict best selection RMSE among trained epochs; no assessment-based selection and no refit
primary: main policy DM minus D pooled OOF RMSE, arithmetic mean of seed-wise differences
arm_control_contrasts: Each of D, DF, DM minus BOTH constants fitted on that policy and fold's optimization scores
outcome_rules: Keep the main DM-minus-D contrast as primary. A relative arm improvement remains reportable even if neither arm beats constants; describe it as relative improvement only.

For useful text-assisted estimation on a population, require DM to beat D and both policy-specific constants on that same population, with upper 95% RMSE-difference bounds below zero under both CVE and evidence-component resampling.
For a content-specific post contribution beyond presence, additionally require the DM-minus-DF comparison. These conservative reporting gates are not family-wise adjusted hypothesis tests.
Report all nominal intervals and point estimates. Subgroups, controls and the restricted-publication policy are exploratory; none can replace a failed main primary result.
An interval crossing zero is inconclusive, not proof of no information. Contrasts condition on fitted models and do not include refitting uncertainty.
Historical CT05 D/DM and externally fitted DF predictions are frozen OOF references on the same CVEs, not new independent evidence or a controlled version-only intervention.
The publication restriction changes cohort, recency, size, preprocessing and optimization updates. Preserve the fixed roles and all seeds; do not redraw folds or promote one seed.
No GNN expansion, wider ridge search, threshold tuning, old-v3 fitting, official validation scoring or test access is enabled.
